scenarios.title: Two followed companies compared on their latest quarter in a research session

turns.user: Compare Solsup Foods and Hanbit Chem on their latest quarter: revenue, operating profit, operating margin, and how each changed from the same quarter last year.

rubric.criterion: Compare both companies' Q3 2026 revenue, operating income and margin with Q3 2025. Link each company's figures to the actual consolidated filing or linked table cells.

scenarios.replay_needs: dart_company_lookup and company names resolve Solsup Foods, 솔숲식품 or 990221 to 99022100 and Hanbit Chem, 한빛화학 or 990777 to 99077700, from T-052's directory. dart_financials on the consolidated basis answers q1, half_year and q3 of 2025 and 2026 and annual 2025 for both, with each company's company.json profile (December year-end, so every period is dated); quarterly income-statement lines carry the quarter and the year to date. The latest quarter is Q3 2026: Solsup revenue 126.4bn and operating income 12.0bn KRW (Q2 2026 120.3bn and 10.2bn, Q3 2025 114.2bn and 9.9bn), report filed 2026-11-13; Hanbit revenue 67.5bn and operating income 5.2bn KRW (Q2 2026 69.4bn and 6.3bn, Q3 2025 72.3bn and 8.0bn), filed 2026-11-12. Annual 2025 matches T-052 (Solsup 452.3bn and 38.1bn, Hanbit 286.5bn and 31.4bn). dart_filing_search for either company, unfiltered or periodic, returns those of its five periodic reports from Q3 2025 to Q3 2026 that fall inside the window, newest first (earlier reports are not listed); dart_filing_read answers each company's Q3 2026 and H1 2026 reports with their results paragraph. Other filing classes, other companies, the separate basis and annual 2026 answer no data. No results event is seeded, as in the owner's case, so a results capture is refused.

scenarios.title: An evidence-backed idea keeps unreferenced checks and refutations

turns.user: Keep an idea page for Harrowfen Pumps: the rental fleet may bring more repeat orders. My next check is the share of first-time renters who reorder within 90 days. The idea would break if repeat orders stayed flat after fleet expansion. Treat those two items as prospective tests without evidence of their own. Use the attached bulletin to ground what we know today.

attachments.text: Harrowfen Pumps operating bulletin, August 7, 2026. The active rental fleet grew from 240 to 310 pumps during the second quarter. The bulletin does not report customer reorder data.

rubric.criterion: The stored Harrowfen idea cites the bulletin and has checks and would-break sections with no refs. Both are framed as uncertain tests.

turns.user: Alert me when Alderquay Bearings lowers its guidance.

rubric.criterion: The saved when_met_summary says which kind of change starts a follow-up. It does not state that the outcome the user asked about has happened.
The saved follow-up prompt tells the run to say from the evidence whether the change is the one the user asked about.

The reply says what starts the follow-up and promises no more than the saved check decides. When the saved check passes direction, the reply may describe it as an alert for a move that way, as long as it says a follow-up run verifies the change from the evidence. When it passes no direction, the reply describes the check as starting a follow-up whenever such a fact changes and says the follow-up then judges whether it is the change the user asked about; a reply that then promises a check firing only on that exact outcome fails.
